sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Giovanni Castellucci, former head of Italy's motorway operator Autostrade per l'Italia, and 31 other people have been convicted over the 2018 collapse of the Ponte Morandi bridge in Genoa, which killed 43 people. Castellucci was sentenced to 12 years in prison, the highest of those convicted in the case, for complicity in multiple counts of manslaughter The post Italy's former head of motorways sentenced to 12 years over Ponte Morandi collapse appeared first on Dezeen .
